notes: #4 was published by Johannes Janssonius and Abraham van Herwijck (Amsterdam). #1–#3 (Braun and Hogenberg vol. 3, 1581) are a near-flat street plan, so the 1617 true view was preferred for P1. #6 is a Corot etching of trees (1913,1213.12 is the British Museum number, not a date). #7 is a good tram-era postcard panorama with Saint-Pierre, but it is dated only by a 1915 postmark; usable as about 1910 if a looser date is acceptable. #8 is a distant countryside panorama where the town is barely visible.
